Pinus Pengger Guide

Pinus Pengger vs HeHa Sky View: Which to Choose?

Both are often compared for the view theme, but sit in different corridors. This page gives a real difference so you can choose.

Updated 28 October 2026

Diff corridor
Dlingo vs Patuk
Character
pines vs night
Check official
HeHa hours/price

Detail

Corridor difference

Pinus Pengger is in the Dlingo pine belt; HeHa Sky View is in the Patuk corridor. Both need a self-arranged vehicle and different travel time.

Detail

Character difference

  • Pinus Pengger: pine forest, timber installations, day–sunset photos.
  • HeHa Sky View: night view, glass floor.
  • HeHa suits a night add-on, not a pine substitute.

Detail

When to choose

Pick Pinus Pengger for forest and photos; pick HeHa for the night view. Combine both in a sunset itinerary if you want both.

Check HeHa's hours and price on the official site; do not assume always open.

Frequently asked questions

Does HeHa replace Pinus Pengger?

No; they have different characters. HeHa is more night view, Pinus Pengger is pine forest.

Must I visit both?

Not necessarily. Choose by time preference; combine in a sunset itinerary if wanted.

What are HeHa's hours and price?

Check the official site hehaskyview.com; this guide sets no figure.

Which is closer to Yogyakarta?

HeHa in the Patuk corridor, Pinus Pengger in Dlingo; time varies. Ask for routes.
